get.summary: List manual holds for a given invoice
get.description: Return a list of all manual holds for a given invoice

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the invoice to retrieve manual holds

id.description: Unique identifier of the manual hold. Use as the {id} path parameter to update it via PATCH /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/payment_readiness/manual_holds/{id}.

status.description: Whether the manual hold is currently applied to (blocking payment on) or released from the invoice or vendor. Either 'applied' or 'released'.

description.description: Free-text explanation of why the manual hold was placed.

created_by.description: Full name of the user who created the manual hold.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the manual hold was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_by.description: Full name of the user who last updated the manual hold.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the manual hold was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this manual hold.

project_id.description: ID of the project this manual hold belongs to. Matches the {project_id} path parameter.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice the hold is placed on. Required when hold_type is `invoice`.

hold_type.description: Scope of the hold. 'invoice' applies it to a single invoice; 'vendor' applies it to the vendor across invoices.

vendor_id.description: ID of the vendor the hold is placed on. Required when hold_type is `vendor`.

visible_to_vendor.description: Whether the hold is visible to the vendor. When true, the vendor can see this hold.

attachments.description: Files attached to the manual hold, such as supporting documentation.

url.description: URL to download the attached file.

filename.description: Original name of the attached file.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attached file.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/payment_readiness/manual_holds?invoice_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
